$description: Jefferson Kidd tokens beyond the palette, read from the JKidd - Foundations Figma library (ADhu9noVbgFbtapMZivOHw; JKidd - DS until 2026-10-14) on 2026-09-24. The palette and the six scheme modes come from jkxo-tertiary.json next to this file. Scheme role names are camelCase here and --md-sys-color-kebab-case in CSS, as in Figma's code syntax.

postTypes.$description: Post Type collection, one mode per type. Each value names a Scheme role, so a type recolours with the scheme. accent: fills (rail, tick, highlight, swatches). ink: text and thin marks (kicker, arrow, check). onAccent: text set on an accent fill. PROVISIONAL (User, 2026-09-24; CONTENT-SYSTEM.md section 9).

canvas.$description: Card Frame (Compositions 252:521) Ratio variants. Judge every card at 320px wide (Principle 4).

fonts.$description: Type collection. Display: Special Elite Even, the repaired cut in fonts/special-elite-repaired (User, 2026-10-11). Body: Inter, for running text. Two comic faces for short text only (User, 2026-10-11): lettering is CC Wild Words (Comicraft, paid; loaded from the machine until a webfont licence is bought), then Anime Ace 2.0 BB (Blambot; also loaded from the machine, never bundled); burst is Bangers (OFL) for loud titles. Mono stays provisional (JKIDD.md decision 1). In Figma (Foundations, Type) since 2026-10-13: font/lettering holds Anime Ace 2.0 BB and font/burst Bangers. The comic faces are Wild Words, Anime Ace and Bangers; Comic Neue is not used (User, 2026-10-13).

textStyles.$description: Text styles read from Figma. letterSpacing is in percent of the font size, as Figma stores it. Read from JKidd - Foundations on 2026-10-13, in Figma order. Display weights are 400: Special Elite Even ships one weight, and the 700/500 kept from Space Grotesk made browsers fake a bold. Doc/Body and Doc/Body Strong read in 2026-10-19, once Figma set them in font/body (Regular and Semi Bold; User). Not read in: Card/Title (Anime Ace 2.0, not bound to a Type variable).

effects.$description: Effect styles read from JKidd - Foundations on 2026-10-13: drop shadows in primary-10 (#001f24) at the opacity Figma gives. blur is Figma's radius.

genres.$description: Genre colours dress a postcard's front and are not the brand palette (POSTCARDS.md section 4; JKIDD.md decision 10). Hex values read from the JKidd - Workbench file (7Q8GN3IPMoM6lhFtIMquya). on names the genre colour used for text set on the fill.

picture.$description: The picture postcard's frame, shared by every series (POSTCARDS.md section 4): the cream mat around the ink-bordered front. The mat is the retired illustrated set's (its Workbench frames were deleted 2026-10-13). Each series brings its own inks as picture-<series>.

picture-western.$description: Western series (Postcard Image Algo 147:933; Blocks board 77:1719): master 'western', with 'greetings-western' and 'desert' on the same press. 'build-in-public-western' (Frontier Town) is the same theme in drifted inks and is left out of the sample. Ink, cream, orange, gold, brown and red were read by hand from the master and match `pnpm front-inks` on the three cards within a few points; teal and dark teal are from `pnpm front-inks` (2026-10-13), replacing the earlier #21a291 and #105a5b, which came from Frontier Town. Accent red is a colour, not a ribbon: neither cream (4.00) nor ink (3.6) reaches 4.5:1 on it. The spec's ink library: orange, cream, cyan, teal, brown, black, olive, accent red.

picture-build-in-public.$description: Build in Public series: master 'greetings-build-in-public', with 'build-crew'. Inks from `pnpm front-inks` on greetings-build-in-public.jpg, build-crew.jpg (2026-10-13): ink is the darkest 3%, cream the lightest pale 5%, each ribbon the purest quarter of a hue that covers the card and carries text at 4.5:1.

stage.$description: The stage postcard: a theatre stage drawn in perspective on graph paper, with stick figures at three depths. Colours are the Architect's Notebook light ink and paper (handdrawn.css; Figma gWBVp3oNqUv7ymJXNORuM0): cream is --hd-paper, paperAlt the flats, grid and gridMajor the paper's rules (gridMajor is --hd-ink-faint), blueprint the dimensions and depth tape, redPen the spike marks. Not in Workbench yet.
